short.title: High volume of work while consistently maintaining high standards

detail.body_html:
I have worked very closely with Álvaro during a couple of years. Álvaro has excelled in this role, exhibiting one of the highest levels of productivity of the team. Álvaro produces a high volume of work while consistently maintaining high standards for quality and accuracy.

Álvaro possesses the ultimate "can do" attitude while taking on all tasks with a positive energy and a smile. His upbeat personality and engaging personal style enable him to interact effectively with clients and staff.

All the intangibles that lead to success in the workplace are in order with Álvaro. There will be no unpleasant surprises and I am confident he will fit in and add to any office morale.

short.title: You won't find this type of profile very often

detail.meta: Senior Data Scientist · former project colleague, 2021–2024
detail.body_html:
Alvaro brings a special profile to the table that is now more relevant than ever: a deep understanding of the tech side and a focus on delivering most value for the users, a great product mindset. He combines this with a great, very approachable character which highly benefits team atmosphere.

He cares deeply, about the work, the product and every single one on the team, including everyone's development, making him a strong motivational factor for each one and thus a driving factor for team productivity.

Further adding to this range of capabilities and talents is the fact that he brings deep experience both working in backend as well as data / data sciences. All combined makes him a great fit for any org with focus on improving their tech and / or AI product.

Simply put: you won't find this type of profile very often. Every org that gets him onboard can count itself lucky. Simply a great guy :).

cards.quote_html: "Alvaro is one of the very few engineers I've worked with that truly has a product mindset—able to abstract from tech entanglement and focus on the human-centered problem space."

short.title: One of the very few with a true product mindset

detail.body_html: Alvaro is on of the very few engineers I've worked with that truly has a product mindset. One that can abstract himself from tech entanglement and focus on the problem / human-centrered space. He understands the importance of experiences and perception, beyond good relevance and elegant architectures.

short.title: Truly honest and elevates everyone around him

detail.meta: Principal Software Engineer · former project colleague, 2021–2024
detail.body_html:
Simplemente, Álvaro es uno de las personas más inteligentes que he conocido a lo largo de mi trayectoria profesional. Su capacidad creativa, visión de conjunto y agudeza natural le convierten en ese tipo tan difícil de encontrar que es capaz de "ver más allá" del problema inmediato.

Puedo afirmar de corazón y de primera mano que es también una persona honesta y auténtica. Muy buen compañero, muy empático. Álvaro hace crecer al grupo de personas a su alrededor.

Cualquier organización que cuente con él estará ganando mucho más de lo que esperaba.
